oracle_correction.description: Test-oracle-only correction: split long external symbol addresses into a zero-addend GOT load and explicit integer offset addition. Original pinned sources and IR remain unchanged.

notes: Fresh 15-library-object builds; immutable LCB snapshots consume pinned original cproc IR.
GCC compiles original C; generated C caller always GCC -O2, no LTO.
Original QBE source unchanged; corrected oracle patch separately recorded, never substituted.
Measured C intervals exclude process startup, file/pipe I/O, allocation of caller buffers and initial correctness checks; API-internal allocation remains included.
VM CPU affinity constrains guest scheduling; host scheduling/frequency still affect timings.
